name: Bonds
source:
Robin is a student in college who has always had a secret interest in being tied up. One day she decides to challenge her roommate and childhood friend, Alicia, to tie her up after they watch a movie featuring a poorly tied damsel in distress. 
Their games then become a more frequent occurrence, and they decide to try to make money off of their new hobby. Eventually things become a little more complicated once a girl from Robin's class shows interest in their activities.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE219914.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
罗宾是一名大学生，他一直对被捆绑有着秘密的兴趣。有一天，她决定挑战她的室友和儿时朋友艾丽西亚，在他们看完一部讲述一个绑得不好的陷入困境的少女的电影后，把她绑起来。
然后他们的游戏变得更加频繁，他们决定尝试从他们的新爱好中赚钱。最终，一旦罗宾班上的一个女孩对他们的活动表现出兴趣，事情就会变得有点复杂。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE219914.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
